assistant.connectionDescription: Uses OpenRouter (openrouter.ai) — one key, many models. The key is stored in this browser, like everything else here.
assistant.apiKeyFromEnv: Filled in from your local .env (VITE_OPENROUTER_API_KEY) — click Save to store it in the vault, or edit it here to use a different key.
assistant.systemPromptDescription: Sent to the model at the start of every conversation. Not translated — always saved and used in whatever language you write it in.

accountsCards.accountsDescription: Each account can have its own Movimentações table (its statement, in and out).
accountsCards.deleteAccountDialogDescription: This permanently deletes the account. This cannot be undone.
accountsCards.deleteBlockedHasDependents: Has a card or table linked to it — archive it instead, or remove those first.
accountsCards.cardsDescription: Every card belongs to one account, the one its invoice is paid from.
accountsCards.addAccountFirst: Add a bank account first — a card always belongs to one.
accountsCards.deleteCardDialogDescription: This permanently deletes the card. This cannot be undone.

categories.unclassifiedDescription: Values found in your data that no rule resolves to a category yet.
categories.categoriesDescription: The canonical list. Deleting one also removes the rules that point at it.
categories.rulesDescription: Maps raw values onto a category — evaluated top to bottom, first match wins.
categories.deleteRuleDialogDescription: Values it matched go back to unclassified — nothing else changes.
